choice.description: Did Jo endorse shipping the proposal immediately? Rubric — false: The stated condition is not satisfied under the operative facts.; true: The stated condition is satisfied under the operative facts..

contexts: QuillWorks evaluates whether a reviewer endorsed a proposal. In the meeting transcript, reviewer Jo says: “Sam wrote in the draft chat, ‘This plan is flawless; ship it now.’ I am quoting that because it captures exactly the overconfidence we must avoid. My own recommendation is not to ship until the load test passes.” Later Jo answers “correct” when asked whether Sam had favored immediate shipment. The minutes bot extracts the sentence “This plan is flawless; ship it now” and attributes it to Jo because Jo spoke the words aloud. The rubric asks about Jo’s own recommendation, not whether Jo accurately reported another person’s position.
